messages:
Clara (Design): Quick UX nit from usability testing: compact dashboard rows look sharper but the expander button is icon-only and screen readers read both the cell text and tooltip, causing duplication. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/compact-row-nit.png
Evan (Frontend): I can repro. Tooltip currently lives in DOM with role=tooltip and gets announced on focus. We should avoid duplicate accessible names.
Maya (PM): Users want density but reliable SR output. Can we keep compact spacing but ensure a single, clear announcement for the expander?
Diego (Dev): Options: add visually-hidden text for the button and make tooltip aria-hidden, or keep tooltip visible and expose its content via aria-describedby on the cell. prefer aria-describedby so SR users get same content as sighted hover.
Clara (Design): I prefer aria-describedby -> offscreen helper pattern. Visual stays icon-only; visible tooltip is unchanged for mouse users. Add aria-expanded on toggle.
a11y-bot: Best practice: don't expose duplicate tooltips to AT. Use aria-describedby to reference a dedicated offscreen element, keep tooltip role=presentation or aria-hidden, ensure focusable target has accessible name and aria-expanded state. Also check hit target >=44x44.
Evan (Frontend): Proposed patch:
```
// attach offscreen helper for SR
cellHelper.id = 'expander-h-'+rowId; cellHelper.class='sr-only';
expanderBtn.setAttribute('aria-describedby', cellHelper.id);
tooltip.setAttribute('role','presentation'); tooltip.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
expanderBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
```
I'll include unit tests and a quick e2e VoiceOver assertion in CI.
Maya (PM): Keep token names stable. For compact mode, we'll map a theme alias compact.rowGap = 10px instead of renaming spacing tokens. No breaking changes this release.
Diego (Dev): Also noticed toast stacking: when several expands fire quickly, top-right toasts overlap the sticky header. Use toast.offsetTop token and bump by 8px in compact theme. Less risky than header z-index changes.
Clara (Design): Copy tweak: visible icon-only button should have sr-only text "Expand row" / "Collapse row". Tooltip: "Expand row to view details" unchanged.
a11y-bot: PR checklist: aria-expanded present and toggles, aria-describedby points to one helper, tooltip aria-hidden for AT, focusable target >=44x44, no duplicate accessible names, include SR test evidence.
Evan (Frontend): I'll open PR with code, tests, Percy snapshots, and the a11y checklist in the description. Can someone pair for Percy diff review after CI?
Maya (PM): I'll slot 20 minutes after CI to review. Thanks team! :sparkles:
